allow: PowerShell($las = Get-Content "las-database.csv"; "LAS file lines: $\($las.Count\)"; \($las | Select-String -Pattern "^\\d+," | Measure-Object\).Count)

Bash(sed -i 's|bg-white rounded-card p-4 border border-dark/8|bg-white rounded-card p-4 border border-dark/[0.05] shadow-card|g; s|bg-white rounded-card border border-dark/8 divide-y|bg-white rounded-card border border-dark/[0.05] shadow-card divide-y|g' "src/app/\(app\)/onboarding/page.tsx")

Bash(sed -i 's|bg-white shadow-card rounded-card px-5 py-5 flex flex-col gap-3|bg-white shadow-card border border-dark/[0.05] rounded-card px-5 py-5 flex flex-col gap-3|' "src/app/\(app\)/test/page.tsx")
Bash(sed -i 's|bg-primary text-cream rounded-card px-4 py-5 text-center|surface-hero text-cream rounded-card px-4 py-6 text-center shadow-hero|' "src/app/\(app\)/test/results/page.tsx")
Bash(sed -i 's|bg-white rounded-card shadow-card px-3 py-3.5 text-center|bg-white rounded-card shadow-card border border-dark/[0.05] px-3 py-3.5 text-center|' "src/app/\(app\)/profile/page.tsx")

PowerShell(Get-Item las-database.csv, ord-database.csv | Select-Object Name, Length; \(Get-Content las-database.csv | Measure-Object -Line\).Lines; \(Get-Content ord-database.csv | Measure-Object -Line\).Lines)
